raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

`amd/Qwen3.8-27B-Quark-AWQ-MXFP4` keeps its MTP (next-token prediction) layer in BF16 and lists it in the Quark `exclude` list by
parameter name, e.g. `mtp.layers.0.mlp.down_proj.weight`: all 15 `mtp.*` entries end in `.weight`. Exclusion is matched against
module names (exact or `re:`), so none of these entries match. Since #39064, `_mtp_quant_config` keeps the Quark config for a draft whose
routed experts are not excluded and relies on the per-layer exclusions to keep the BF16 modules BF16; this dense MTP has no experts, so its
linears are built as packed MXFP4 parameters and loading the BF16 MTP tensors fails:

```
Qwen3_5ForCausalLMMTP.load_weights -> load_merged_column_weight: AssertionError (assert param_data.shape == loaded_weight.shape)
```

MTP speculative decoding therefore cannot start on this checkpoint without editing its `config.json`.

#36158 (checkpoint probe for MTP quantization) does not cover this case: it asks the checkpoint only when the exclude list names no
`mtp.*` layer, and this checkpoint names all of them. Checked on MI355X: current main + #36158, rebased so that #39064's rule stays in force when `mtp.*` entries exist, fails with the same assertion.

## Modifications

`QuarkConfig` normalizes its `exclude` list when the config is read: a plain (non-`re:`) entry that ends in `.weight` is reduced to its
module name. Regex entries are kept as written. Tests in a new file,
`test/registered/unit/layers/quantization/test_quark_exclude_param_names.py`: the checkpoint's 15 `.weight` entries keep the MTP
linears unquantized (fused `qkv_proj` / `gate_up_proj` included) and leave target layers quantized; regex and module-name entries are
unchanged.

## Accuracy Tests

MI355X, TP1, upstream main 8080507c3e, `--attention-backend aiter --kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3`, MTP 3/1/4
(`--speculative-algorithm EAGLE --speculative-num-steps 3 --speculative-eagle-topk 1 --speculative-num-draft-tokens 4`), unmodified
checkpoint:

| upstream main 8080507c3e + | MTP draft loads | smoke (1 text + 1 image request) | accept length |
|---|---|---|---|
| nothing | no: `load_merged_column_weight` AssertionError | - | - |
| #36158, rebased onto main (#39064's rule kept) | no: same AssertionError | - | - |
| #36158 as written (any `mtp.*` exclude -> unquantized MTP, the rule #39064 narrowed) | yes | both complete | 2.66 (8k/1k, 4 concurrent) |
| this PR | yes | both complete | 2.73 (smoke), 2.63 (8k/1k, 4 concurrent, 494 tok/s) |

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not a performance change (config parsing only).

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the Format code with pre-commit guide (pre-commit passes on the changed files).
- [x] Add unit tests: `test_quark_exclude_param_names.py` (77 passed, 39 subtests passed on MI355X together with test_qwen3_5_mtp_quant_config, test_quark_config, test_quark_utils).
- [ ] Update documentation: not needed.
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results (above).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style guidance.

detail.title: [Fix] [AMD] quark: Match exclude entries that name a parameter (.weight) by module

files.patch:
@@ -53,6 +53,23 @@
 __all__ = ["QuarkLinearMethod", "QuarkFusedMoEMethod"]
 
 
+def _exclude_module_names(exclude: List[str]) -> List[str]:
+    """Name every `exclude` entry by its module.
+
+    Exclusion is matched against module names (`mtp.fc`), but some Quark exports
+    list the parameter instead (`mtp.fc.weight`; amd/Qwen3.8-27B-Quark-AWQ-MXFP4
+    does this for its bf16 MTP layer). Such an entry would match nothing and the
+    module would be built quantized against bf16 checkpoint shards, so drop the
+    `.weight` suffix of plain names. Regex (`re:`) entries are kept as written.
+    """
+    return [
+        name.removesuffix(".weight")
+        if isinstance(name, str) and not name.startswith("re:")
+        else name
+        for name in exclude
+    ]
+
+
 def _parse_nvfp4_excludes(hf_quant_config: Dict[str, Any]) -> List[str]:
     """Extract NVFP4 producer-declared excludes as `re:` patterns.
 
@@ -356,7 +373,9 @@ def __init__(
         self.kv_cache_group = kv_cache_group
         self.kv_cache_config = kv_cache_config
         self.pack_method = pack_method
-        self.exclude_layers = cast(list[str], self.quant_config.get("exclude", []))
+        self.exclude_layers = _exclude_module_names(
+            cast(list[str], self.quant_config.get("exclude", []))
+        )
         # Both are consumed by _is_draft_layer(), which has to tell an appended
         # MTP/NextN draft layer from a target-model one. "No draft stack" is
         # spelled None as often as it is spelled absent -- ModelConfig defaults

@@ -0,0 +1,72 @@
+import unittest
+
+from sglang.srt.layers.quantization.quark.quark import _exclude_module_names
+from sglang.srt.layers.quantization.quark.utils import should_ignore_layer
+from sglang.srt.models.qwen3_5_mtp import Qwen3_5ForCausalLMMTP
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=13, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+# amd/Qwen3.8-27B-Quark-AWQ-MXFP4 (dense, all 15 mtp.* entries): the bf16 MTP
+# layer is listed by parameter name, with a `.weight` suffix.
+_DENSE_WEIGHT_SUFFIX_EXCLUDES = [
+    "mtp.fc.weight",
+    "mtp.layers.0.input_layernorm.weight",
+    "mtp.layers.0.mlp.down_proj.weight",
+    "mtp.layers.0.mlp.gate_proj.weight",
+    "mtp.layers.0.mlp.up_proj.weight",
+    "mtp.layers.0.post_attention_layernorm.weight",
+    "mtp.layers.0.self_attn.k_norm.weight",
+    "mtp.layers.0.self_attn.k_proj.weight",
+    "mtp.layers.0.self_attn.o_proj.weight",
+    "mtp.layers.0.self_attn.q_norm.weight",
+    "mtp.layers.0.self_attn.q_proj.weight",
+    "mtp.layers.0.self_attn.v_proj.weight",
+    "mtp.norm.weight",
+    "mtp.pre_fc_norm_embedding.weight",
+    "mtp.pre_fc_norm_hidden.weight",
+]
+
+
+class TestQuarkExcludeParamNames(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_weight_suffixed_excludes_keep_dense_mtp_layers_bf16(self):
+        """Excludes that name parameters must still exclude their modules.
+
+        Matched as written, `mtp.layers.0.self_attn.q_proj.weight` never equals a
+        module name, so the draft's linears were built MXFP4 and loading the bf16
+        checkpoint shards failed a shape assertion.
+        """
+        excludes = _exclude_module_names(_DENSE_WEIGHT_SUFFIX_EXCLUDES)
+        for module in (
+            "mtp.fc",
+            "mtp.layers.0.self_attn.qkv_proj",
+            "mtp.layers.0.self_attn.o_proj",
+            "mtp.layers.0.mlp.gate_up_proj",
+            "mtp.layers.0.mlp.down_proj",
+        ):
+            with self.subTest(module=module):
+                self.assertTrue(
+                    should_ignore_layer(
+                        module,
+                        ignore=excludes,
+                        fused_mapping=Qwen3_5ForCausalLMMTP.packed_modules_mapping,
+                    )
+                )
+        self.assertFalse(
+            should_ignore_layer(
+                "model.layers.0.mlp.gate_up_proj",
+                ignore=excludes,
+                fused_mapping=Qwen3_5ForCausalLMMTP.packed_modules_mapping,
+            )
+        )
+
+    def test_exclude_module_names_keeps_regex_and_module_entries(self):
+        self.assertEqual(
+            _exclude_module_names(["mtp.fc.weight", "mtp.fc", "re:.*proj.weight"]),
+            ["mtp.fc", "mtp.fc", "re:.*proj.weight"],
+        )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
